summary: PicS N.V. filed a Form 6-K enclosing a convocation notice for its 2026 annual general meeting (AGM) to be held on 30 June 2026 in Amstelveen, Netherlands. The agenda includes discussion of the 2025 annual report, adoption of 2025 annual accounts, explanation of dividend policy, and discharge of directors. No special-situations event such as a merger, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, or restructuring is mentioned. This is a routine shareholder meeting filing as a foreign private issuer on Form 6-K under Rule 13a-16.
